title: measureRAG: a budget-aware retrieval and RAG benchmark in Czech and English, for a single machine with no network access
description: measureRAG is a budget-aware benchmark for retrieval and retrieval-augmented generation on a single CPU-only machine with no network access, in Czech and English. It imposes a deployment budget of memory and latency first and reports answer quality inside it, and it asks whether the next gigabyte buys more as a stronger retriever or as a bigger generator. On HotpotQA and Natural Questions the answer is a break-even gold-gain table rather than a located crossover, and Czech retrieval and Czech RAG are measured alongside.
